OpenWrt ships code not only licensed via GPL-2.0-{only,or-later}.
Reflect that by adding the missing licenses, just like the kernel
does.

This patch takes the license text as it is found in the Linux
kernel, which might probably be the best common denominator here.

In contrast to the kernel versions, only some changes to the
valid and recommended identifiers were made (GPL-x.x+ vs.
GPL-x.x-or-later and similar).

Suggested-by: Paul Spooren <mail@aparcar.org>

class="react-directory-row-commit-cell"><div><div class="react-directory-commit-message"><a data-pjax="true" title="toolchain: Include ./include/fortify for external musl toolchain

When building with an external toolcahin with musl also include
./include/fortify by default. This is also done when we build with the
internal toolchain using musl libc.

Without this extra include the fortify source feature is not working
when using an external musl toolchain. All binaries were compiled
without fortify source when an external musl toolchain was used. All
binaries release done by the OpenWrt project use the internal toolcahin
where fortify source is working.

Signed-off-by: Hauke Mehrtens <hauke@hauke-m.de>

the new grep versions this creates warnings.

  Regular expressions with stray backslashes now cause warnings, as
  their unspecified behavior can lead to unexpected results.
  For example, '\a' and 'a' are not always equivalent
  <https://bugs.gnu.org/39678>.

  grep: warning: stray \ before /

<p dir="auto">OS: <code>Ubuntu 20.04 (focal)</code></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Install dependencies</span>
sudo add-apt-repository ppa:npalix/coccinelle
sudo apt update
sudo apt install build-essential clang flex g++ gawk gcc-multilib gettext \
  git libncurses5-dev libssl-dev python3-distutils rsync unzip zlib1g-dev \
  coccinelle

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Clone this repo</span>
git clone https://github.com/hzyitc/openwrt-redmi-ax3000
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> openwrt-redmi-ax3000

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Update and install feeds</span>
./scripts/feeds update -a
./scripts/feeds install -a

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Configure</span>
make menuconfig

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Download</span>
make -j16 download

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Build</span>

<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c1">cd</span> /tmp
wget https://github.com/hzyitc/openwrt-redmi-ax3000/releases/latest/download/openwrt-ipq50xx-arm-redmi_ax3000-squashfs-nand-factory.ubi

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Check your partition table</span>
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> cat /proc/mtd</span>
[[ <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">$(</span>grep <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>"rootfs"<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span> /proc/mtd <span class="pl-k">|</span> cut -d<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>:<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span> -f1<span class="pl-pds">)</span></span><span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> <span class="pl-k">==</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>mtd18<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> ]] <span class="pl-k">||</span> <span class="pl-c1">exit</span>
[[ <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">$(</span>grep <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>"rootfs_1"<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span> /proc/mtd <span class="pl-k">|</span> cut -d<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>:<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span> -f1<span class="pl-pds">)</span></span><span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> <span class="pl-k">==</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>mtd19<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> ]] <span class="pl-k">||</span> <span class="pl-c1">exit</span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Detect the current system slot and flash into the other one</span>
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> cat /proc/cmdline</span>
mtd=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">$(</span>grep -oE <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>ubi.mtd=[a-zA-Z0-9\-\_]*<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span> /proc/cmdline <span class="pl-k">|</span> cut -d<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>=<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span> -f2<span class="pl-pds">)</span></span><span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
<span class="pl-k">if</span> [[ <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span><span class="pl-smi">$mtd</span><span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> <span class="pl-k">==</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>rootfs<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> ]]<span class="pl-k">;</span> <span class="pl-k">then</span>
	<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Flash it as system 2</span>
	ubiformat /dev/mtd19 -f openwrt-ipq50xx-arm-redmi_ax3000-squashfs-nand-factory.ubi
	nvram <span class="pl-c1">set</span> flag_try_sys2_failed=0
	nvram <span class="pl-c1">set</span> flag_boot_rootfs=1
